in_sanskrit.name: निखिलेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the Lord within himself, the all-pervading one.

in_hindi.name: निखिलेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who looks after everyone, the all-nurturing one.

in_tamil.name: நிகிலேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is beyond the mundane world, the transcendental one.

in_telugu.name: నిఖిలేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the Lord within his being, the divine one.

in_marathi.name: Nikhilesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikhilesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nikhilesh is derived from Sanskrit, where Ni stands for 'Lord' and Khil stands for 'Universe'. This name signifies the one who is the Lord of the Universe, and is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology.
